text: おじいさん　カンナちゃんが　まだ　ちーさい　ときに　ポケモン　おしえて　やったんだよ

structure.jp: カンナちゃんが　まだ　ちーさい　ときに
structure.en: when little Lorelei was still small

structure.jp: ポケモン　おしえて　やったんだよ
structure.en: taught her about Pokémon, you know

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form says you do something for someone younger or lower than you. おしえて やった = 'taught (her) as a favor'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a describing word means 'when' things were that way. ちーさい ときに = 'when she was small'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ (short for のだ) here gives an explanation the listener should take in. やったんだ = 'I did it, you see'.
